title: GTA 6 Won't Let You Rob a Bank on Day One 🏦 #Shorts
description:
Rockstar told The Guardian (Nov 14, 2026 preview at Rockstar North) that Jason and Lucia start out as small-time criminals: at first they can only hotwire low-end cars and pick basic locks, and early targets are gas stations and convenience stores. Banks and high-end jewelry stores come later. Prep helps: scout a back way in, disable security cameras or steal the footage. Skip it and bystanders can report you or film you on their phones.

Sources: The Guardian preview, as reported by Output Lag and Shane the Gamer (Nov 2026). Footage: official Rockstar Games GTA VI trailers and screenshots.
GTA VI launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
